product.food_additive_text: 6 (3)(e) Additive(s) (i) For products in tablet/capsule/pills/liquid format: Only additives as specified by the FA from time to time. Refer to the link for the table List of food additives for Food for special Dietary Use. https://foodocopoeia.fssai.gov.in/PDF/Annexure%203v1.pdf (ii) For products other than tablet/capsule/pills/liquid format: Only additiveswithin the limits specified as permitted for category 13.5 and GMP table (GMP Table Provisions For all Food Categories) ofAppendix ‘A’ of FSS (FPS & FA) Regulations, 2011 are permitted. 6 (3.1.1)(c) Additives (FSDU for Weight management Only additives within the limits specified as permitted for category 13.5 of Appendix ‘A’ and GMP table (GMP Table Provisions For all Food Categories) of FSS (FPS & FA) Regulations, 2011 are permitted.
